# GCS El Salvador

> Grupo Integral De Construcciones y Servicios (GCS) is a construction, engineering, and permitting company based in El Salvador with over 10 years of experience, 50+ team members, and a $37M+ project portfolio.

## About

GCS El Salvador provides end-to-end construction services across Central America and the United States. The company specializes in navigating complex regulatory environments, delivering residential and commercial projects, and providing heavy equipment for large-scale operations.

- Website: https://gcs.sv
- Email: services@gcs.sv
- Languages: English, Spanish
- Location: El Salvador

## Services

- **Permitting & Regulatory Management**: OPAMSS pre-procedures, site qualification, hydrological studies, institutional coordination
- **Engineering & Design**: Conceptual design, land surveys, topography, structural plans, BIM modeling
- **Residential Construction**: Custom homes, apartment complexes, multi-unit developments
- **Commercial Construction**: Restaurants, retail, offices, wellness complexes
- **Heavy Equipment Rental**: Excavators, cranes, concrete mixers, dump trucks

## Key Facts

- Portfolio Value: $37.73M+
- Active Projects: 19+
- Years Experience: 10+
- Team Members: 50+

## Notable Projects

- Rental Units Building — Santa Tecla, El Salvador
- Apartamentos Kawok — San Salvador, El Salvador
